notes:
• Terminal panes in the desktop app draw in JetBrains Mono with real bold and italic, and braille, Powerline and icons draw instead of boxes.
• Shift+Enter starts a new line in Claude Code and Codex, and terminal panes gain search, Cmd-click links, file drops and terminal selection.
• Keys reach a terminal program in a fraction of a millisecond, even as its pane floods with output, and closing a pane closes its terminal.
• What you queue with Tab, or type during an account change, is still yours when it runs, and an account change no longer freezes ZTC.
changes: What you queue is still yours when it runs.
ZTC no longer freezes when an error clears during an account change.
The desktop app's Send now runs a queued command; it no longer gives it to the model.
The desktop app's Send now waits for an account or model change.
A line typed during an account or model change can be edited, removed and sent from the queue.
The terminal's queue editor keeps a queued image that has no text.
Saving settings never leaves config.json half written.
Panes an agent opens follow your settings.
Narrowing a desktop terminal pane no longer takes memory out of all proportion to what it keeps.
A font size in ZTerm's settings file is read into the range zoom allows, 9 to 28 points.
Closing a desktop terminal pane closes its terminal.
Shift+Enter and Option+Enter start a new line in Claude Code and Codex in the desktop app.
Left Option is Alt and right Option types characters in terminal panes.
Scrollback keys in terminal panes.
Input methods compose at the cursor, and dropped files paste their paths.
Selecting in terminal panes works as it does in a terminal.
Search in terminal panes lights each match and moves between them.
Search in terminal panes holds up over wide characters that line editing or a resize cut short or moved.
Cmd-click opens links in terminal panes.
Pastes of any length reach the program.
A pane that rings or notifies wears a badge until you look at it.
Programs can copy to the clipboard and ask the terminal about itself.
A new split opens where the focused pane is working
Claude Code panes in the desktop app redraw without tearing
Every underline style is drawn in terminal panes.
Programs can set the colours their pane draws in.
A cursor a program asks to blink blinks.
A scrolled-back terminal pane shows the lines it is scrolled to.
Bold, dim and the cursor are drawn as the program asks in terminal panes.
"process exited" never covers a pane's output.
Escape ends a search, so no terminal pane keeps its matches lit.
Cmd-C copies exactly the text you selected
The mouse wheel and trackpad scroll vim, less, htop and similar programs one line per row of movement
Programs get answers to their queries at once.
A pane resized so narrow that it splits a wide character keeps showing its cursor.
Braille, sextants, Nerd Font icons, Powerline separators and Claude Code's and Codex's symbols draw instead of empty boxes
ZTC's own panes draw what ZTC sends them.
Selecting in ZTC's own panes takes whole characters.
A window title a program sets is kept as printable text.
Pasting control characters into a program without bracketed paste asks first.
